test_title: SSC CPO 2024 Official Paper-I (Held On: 28 Jun, 2024 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
Select the most appropriate idiom that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.

We need to make sure that criminals like these get more from the authorities than a __very mild punishment__.

options.text: a taste of their own medicine

solution: The correct answer is **Option 1)** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__** __ • The idiom **"a slap on the wrist"** means a very mild or light punishment. (हल्की सजा) • **Example: **The CEO received nothing more than **a slap on the wrist **for his involvement in the scandal. • **"an axe to grind"** refers to having a personal issue or grievance with someone. (कोई व्यक्तिगत शिकायत होना) • **Example: **She has **an axe to grind **with her former employer, which is why she is so critical of them. • **"a blessing in disguise"** refers to something that initially seems bad but turns out to be good. (छुपा हुआ वरदान) • **Example: **Losing that job was** a blessing in disguise**; it gave me the push I needed to start my own business. • **"a taste of their own medicine"** means to treat someone the same unpleasant way they have treated others. (जैसे को तैसा) • **Example: **After years of bullying others, he finally got** a taste of his own medicine.** Therefore, the correct idiom for the given phrase is: **a slap on the wrist**. [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__** Here are the other options explained along with their Hindi meanings and example sentences: • **an axe to grind** (कोई व्यक्तिगत शिकायत होना): Having a personal issue or grievance with someone. • **Example:** She has** an axe to grind** with her former employer, which is why she is so critical of them. • **a blessing in disguise** (छुपा हुआ वरदान): Something that initially seems bad but turns out to be good. • **Example: **Losing that job was** a blessing in disguise**; it gave me the push I needed to start my own business. • **a taste of their own medicine** (जैसे को तैसा): Treating someone the same unpleasant way they have treated others. • **Example:** After years of bullying others, he finally got** a taste of his own medicine.** 33e:Tc35, The correct answer is **Option 3)**
